Create function CDN.AtrPobierzWartosc(@OBITyp smallint, @OBINumer int, @OBILp smallint, @OBISubLp smallint, @ATkID int, @TimeStamp int) Returns varchar(100) as Begin Declare @lHistoria int Declare @lOkresowe int Declare @sWynik varchar(100) Declare @data int
if (@timestamp<0) select @data = -@timestamp, @timestamp = 86400 * (@data-69035) else set @data = (@timestamp/86400 + 69035)
Select @lHistoria = ATK_Historia, @lOkresowe = ATK_Okresowe from cdn.atrybutyklasy Where Atk_ID = @AtkId
if (@lHistoria = 0 and @lOkresowe = 0) select @sWynik = Atr_Wartosc from cdn.atrybuty where ATR_OBITyp = @OBITyp and ATR_OBINumer = @OBINumer and ATR_OBILp = @OBILp and ATR_OBISubLp = @OBISubLp and ATR_AtkID = @AtkID else begin if ( @lOkresowe =1) select @sWynik = AtH_Wartosc from cdn.atrybutyHist where ATH_OBITyp = @OBITyp and ATH_OBINumer = @OBINumer and ATH_OBILp = @OBILp and ATH_OBISubLp = @OBISubLp and ATH_AtkID = @AtkID and ATH_TimeStamp<=@data and ATH_TimeStampDo>=@data order by ATH_TimeStamp desc else select @sWynik = AtH_Wartosc from cdn.atrybutyHist where ATH_OBITyp = @OBITyp and ATH_OBINumer = @OBINumer and ATH_OBILp = @OBILp and ATH_OBISubLp = @OBISubLp and ATH_AtkID = @AtkID and ATH_TimeStamp<=@TimeStamp order by ATH_TimeStamp End
return @sWynik
end
